what.text: This page follows refugees from Türkiye in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 149405 refugees from Türkiye.
Germany hosts the largest share, 33.0%, followed by France, Canada and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in Turkey between the government and the PKK from 1984 to 2013 and from 2015 to 2025, at war level in some years.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Turkey in several years, including with TAK and Yurtta Sulh Konseyi in 2016.
Armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Turkey is recorded from 2015 to 2017.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1972 at 250 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 227236, at the end of 2006, and was lower by the end of 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2012 and 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, and the data shows many large jumps between 1983 and 1995.
